documentation: If specified, divide the value by this amount and use the resulting remainder. This is applied after quotient division.

fields.name: step
documentation: If specified, round the value to multiples of this step. This is applied after all division.

fields.name: rounding
documentation: If specified, rounding mode to apply to the step.

fields.name: Preserve
documentation: Do not strip any whitespace from interval unit strings.

fields.name: Strip
documentation: Strip whitespace from interval unit strings. Some locales override this setting (eg. deDE, ruRU).

fields.name: StripIgnoreLocale
documentation: Always strip whitespace from interval unit strings even if the client locale should normally preserve whitespace.

fields.name: NeverSecret
documentation: Will never yield secret values when queried.

fields.name: AlwaysSecret
documentation: Will always yield secret values when queried.

fields.name: ContextuallySecret
documentation: May yield secret values when queried depending upon factors such as addon restriction states, unit disposition, etc.

fields.name: chatType
documentation: Chat type string ('SAY', 'EMOTE', etc.). Defaults to 'SAY' if not specified.

fields.name: languageID
documentation: Language to send the message in.

fields.name: target
documentation: Name of the player to send a message to. Only applies to chat types that support targeted messages.

fields.name: currentCharges
documentation: Number of charges currently available

fields.name: maxCharges
documentation: Max number of charges that can be accumulated

fields.name: cooldownStartTime
documentation: If charge cooldown is active, time at which the most recent charge cooldown began; 0 if cooldown is not active

fields.name: cooldownDuration
documentation: Cooldown duration in seconds required to generate a charge

fields.name: chargeModRate
documentation: Rate at which cooldown UI should update

fields.name: isActive
documentation: False if recharging is not active (ex: at maximum available charges, start time or duration are zero); True otherwise

fields.name: startTime
documentation: If cooldown is active, time started; 0 if no cooldown; Current time if isEnabled is false

fields.name: duration
documentation: Cooldown duration in seconds if active; 0 if cooldown is inactive

fields.name: isEnabled
documentation: False if cooldown is on hold (ex: some cooldowns only start after an active spell is cancelled); True otherwise

fields.name: isActive
documentation: False if cooldown is not active (ex: not enabled, or startTime or duration are 0); True otherwise

fields.name: modRate
documentation: Rate at which cooldown UI should update

fields.name: activeCategory
documentation: Indicates which category is responsible for determining the duration. A nil value indicates the duration was determined through some other logic, e.g. the spell is on hold.

fields.name: timeUntilEndOfStartRecovery
documentation: When this is set it indicates that the spell is in recovery and this is how long it will be until that recovery period is finished

fields.name: isOnGCD
documentation: Whether or not this spell is considered to be on the global cooldown, do not trust this field unless responding to a SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN event

fields.name: iconID
documentation: Icon for this spell; If spell has been overriden, this may be the icon for the overriding spell; See originalIconID for spell's non-overriden icon

fields.name: startTime
documentation: If cooldown is active, time started; 0 if no cooldown

fields.name: duration
documentation: Cooldown duration in seconds if active; 0 if cooldown is inactive

fields.name: modRate
documentation: Rate at which cooldown UI should update

fields.name: isActive
documentation: False if cooldown is not active (startTime or duration are 0); True otherwise

fields.name: shouldReplaceNormalCooldown
documentation: True if this cooldown should be displayed in-place of the normal action cooldown (ex: the LoC cooldown expires later than the normal cooldown); False otherwise

fields.name: name
documentation: The name or 'power token' for this power type (ex: MANA, FOCUS, etc)

fields.name: cost
documentation: Full cost including optional cost; Optional cost is cost the spell will use but isn't required (ex: Rogue spell might cost 1CP but have optional cost of up to 5 more)

fields.name: minCost
documentation: Cost excluding optional cost; This is min required to cast the spell

fields.name: costPercent
documentation: Cost as a percentage of base maximum resource; May be 0 if the cost is simply a flat cost

fields.name: costPerSec
documentation: Cost as a percentage of base maximum resource consumed per second, used by channel spells; May be 0 if cost is simply a flat cost

fields.name: requiredAuraID
documentation: An aura the caster must have for the cost to apply; Usually based on things like active spec or shapeshift form

fields.name: hasRequiredAura
documentation: True if there is a requiredAuraID and the caster currently has that aura; Caster is either the current player or their pet, depending on spell type

fields.name: Standard
documentation: Fills the bar regularly, either in a left-to-right or top-to-bottom direction as values increase.

fields.name: StandardNoRangeFill
documentation: Similar to standard, except if the range between the min and max values is zero instead render as-if the bar were 100% full. If the min and max values are both zero, will render as 0% full.

fields.name: Center
documentation: Fills the bar in an outward growing manner from the center.

fields.name: Reverse
documentation: Inverse of Standard, filling right-to-left or bottom-to-top as values increase.

fields.name: Immediate
documentation: Immediately snap to the target value with no interpolation.

fields.name: ExponentialEaseOut
documentation: Interpolate the bar toward the target value with exponential ease-out style decay.

fields.name: ElapsedTime
documentation: Calculate status timer bar values using the elapsed time of a duration.

fields.name: RemainingTime
documentation: Calculate status timer bar values using the remaining time of a duration.

fields.name: maintainColor
documentation: If true, preserve all '|c' and '|r' quoted code sequences.

fields.name: maintainBrackets
documentation: If true, preserve all '[' and ']' characters.

fields.name: stripNewlines
documentation: If true, remove all '|n' quoted code sequences.

fields.name: maintainAtlases
documentation: If true, preserve all balanced '|A' and '|a' quoted code sequences.

fields.name: maintainTextures
documentation: If true, preserve all balanced '|T' and '|t' quoted code sequences.

fields.name: isMet
documentation: True if the source for the condition has been fulfilled.

fields.name: isSufficient
documentation: True if meeting the requirements for the condition means any nodes using this condition are considered fulfilled if the condition is met.

fields.name: type
documentation: The value from the TraitConditionType enum the condition uses.

fields.name: definitionID
documentation: Nil on SubTreeSelection Node Entries

fields.name: subTreeID
documentation: Populated only on SubTreeSelection Node Entries; This is the SubTree that is activated if this Entry is chosen

fields.name: isDisplayError
documentation: True if this entry fails the TRAIT_CONDITION_TYPE_DISPLAY_ERROR condition check. Used to communicate a problem with the node to the player (e.g. A prerequisite node has not been purchased.) but will not prevent the player from spending points on the node.

fields.name: isDisplayError
documentation: True if this node fails the TRAIT_CONDITION_TYPE_DISPLAY_ERROR condition check. Used to communicate a problem with the node to the player (e.g. A prerequisite node has not been purchased.) but will not prevent the player from spending points on the node.

fields.name: entryIDToRanksIncreased
documentation: A map of the entry IDs on this node to the number of ranks increased. This covers all entries on the node, which is important in the case of selection nodes where we have more than one option that could be increased.

fields.name: subTreeID
documentation: The SubTree this Node belongs to; Nil if it is not part of a SubTree

fields.name: subTreeActive
documentation: True if this node has a SubTreeID, and the SubTree is chosen or staged; May be nil if not part of a SubTree at all

fields.name: subTreeSelectionNodeIDs
documentation: SubTreeSelectionNodes whose choice entries include this SubTree

fields.name: posX
documentation: Center X node position calculated from the posX values of all of this subTree's nodes

fields.name: posY
documentation: Topmost Y node position taken from the posY values of all of this subTree's nodes

fields.name: alwaysShowItem
documentation: For internal testing only

fields.name: Unsorted
documentation: Applies no sorting to auras.

fields.name: Default
documentation: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by the player, else whether or not the player can apply the aura, and finally by aura instance ID.

fields.name: BigDefensive
documentation: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by another player, else by expiration time (longest to shortest), and finally by aura instance ID.

fields.name: Expiration
documentation: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by the player, else whether or not the player can apply the aura, then by expiration time (soonest to longest, followed by permanent auras), and finally by aura instance ID.

fields.name: ExpirationOnly
documentation: Sorts auras according only to expiration time.

fields.name: Name
documentation: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by the player, else whether or not the player can apply the aura, then by spell name, and finally by aura instance ID.

fields.name: NameOnly
documentation: Sorts auras according only their spell name.

fields.name: MissingHealth
documentation: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of missing health with incoming heals subtracted.

fields.name: MissingHealthWithoutIncomingHeals
documentation: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of missing health. Incoming heals do not decrease missing health.

fields.name: MaximumHealth
documentation: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of maximum health.

fields.name: amount
documentation: Amount of applied damage absorb affects with potential reductions from clamping included.

fields.name: clamped
documentation: If true, the value is in excess of the clamp boundary.

fields.name: CurrentHealth
documentation: Clamp heal absorb values to the amount of current health.

fields.name: MaximumHealth
documentation: Clamp heal absorb values to the amount of maximum health.

fields.name: amount
documentation: Amount of applied heal absorb affects with potential reductions from incoming heals and clamping included.

fields.name: clamped
documentation: If true, the value is in excess of the clamp boundary.

fields.name: ReducedByIncomingHeals
documentation: Reduce heal absorb values by incoming heals, and vice versa, clamping to zero where necessary.

fields.name: Total
documentation: Use heal absorb and incoming heal values as-is without any reductions.

fields.name: MissingHealth
documentation: Clamp incoming heal values to the amount of missing health with overflow applied.

fields.name: MaximumHealth
documentation: Clamp incoming heal values to the amount of maximum health.

fields.name: amount
documentation: Amount of incoming heals across all units with potential reductions from heal absorb effects included.

fields.name: amountFromHealer
documentation: Amount of incoming heals from the healer unit. Will never exceed the all-units value.

fields.name: amountFromOthers
documentation: Amount of incoming heals from units other than theh healer. Calculated as the difference between amount and amount-from-healer.

fields.name: clamped
documentation: If true, the value is in excess of the clamp boundary.

fields.name: Default
documentation: Use maximum unit health as-is without adjustments.

fields.name: WithAbsorbs
documentation: Use maximum unit health with total damage absorb shields added.
